The '''Firefrost Reactor Facility''' was a cave compound belonging to the [[White Maw]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] organization that lay beneath the [[Chilling Death Spire]] in the [[Glacial Fissure]] region on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. The facility was one of two that supplied power to the [[Ray shield/Legends|ray shields]] that guarded the White Maw's depot in the wrecked ''[[Star of Coruscant]]'' dreadnought, and the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] known as the [[Hero of Tython]] raided the compound in order to deactivate the shield around [[3642 BBY]].
